item.title: Building a Flight Spotter iOS App
item.description:
Building a Flight Spotter iOS App

This post documents my journey of building a flight spotter iOS application. I’ll cover the technical decisions, challenges faced, and lessons learned throughout the development process.

Project Overview

The Flight Spotter app allows users to:

  • Track nearby aircraft in real-time
  • View flight details and aircraft information
  • Get notifications for interesting aircraft
  • Save favorite aircraft and routes

Technical Stack

  • Language: Swift
  • Architecture: MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel)
  • Key Frameworks:
    • SwiftUI for UI
    • CoreLocation for GPS
    • MapKit for mapping
    • Core Data for persistence
